corrections.caveats: Enricher: the Chapter-04 CMakeLists sets no build type, so a plain configure builds unoptimised and std::min stays a function call. GCC documents [[gnu::optimize]] as a debugging aid that can drop other optimisation flags (search snippet; gcc.gnu.org unreachable), affecting both sides. Open issue #15 (2026-03-05): the book text implies [[unlikely]] on the clamp branch; the maintainer says the code is right and the compiler puts the store path out of line anyway; the data make the branch 99.6% taken, so such a hint would be wrong.

Enricher: the RNG draw sits inside the timed loop and the lookups are independent, so ns per lookup is overlapped throughput, not latency, and the RNG cost compresses the 6.5x and 9.2x ratios (no RNG-only baseline). No build type in the Chapter-05 CMakeLists. operator[] is not usable on const maps; the make_map template-template parameter needs P0522 (Clang 19+, or GCC in C++17 mode); the code relies on transitive includes for <map>, <unordered_map> and <deque>; vcpkg.json omits benchmark and gtest. Ordered alternatives land at 0.9-1.45x of std::map (derived).
